summary: Returns generic not-found responses for missing runtime process instances without changing tenant or runtime authorization.
userImpact: Completed or unknown process IDs queried through an authorized engine no longer become internal errors on runtime instance endpoints.

changes: Runtime process-instance authorization and read handlers classify only typed engine.read HTTP404 as generic NOT_FOUND.
Historic process-instance handling shares the same classification; other typed errors retain their identity and unknown errors remain sanitized.
Documents all nine runtime instance-read paths at explicit tenant and tenant-host compatibility URLs, including required engine selectors, authentication and typed error envelopes.

security: Authentication, engine tenancy, runtime-resource permissions and private engine transport remain mandatory.
Unknown errors and upstream response bodies are not disclosed; upstream authorization or availability failures are not classified as not found.

customerDocumentation.reason: Technical HTTP error classification; no changed administrator setup or user workflow.

knownLimitations: A published image remains immutable; deployments require a newly qualified forward release.
rollback: Revert the application image; there are no data changes to undo.
validation: Both production and modular routers cover engine-wide and resource-aware missing IDs, concurrent removal between guard and handler, foreign engine denial, typed upstream failures and lookalikes.
Protected candidate, current exact-image security, database portability and post-upgrade API denial acceptance remain required.
